title: Preflight Cookbook: Release Choreography for SDK + API (Function Calling / Structured Output / Streaming)
creator: Marco Valdez
description: Purpose: Create a single preflight 'cookbook' that codifies the end-to-end launch choreography for SDK + API surface features (function calling, structured output, streaming). This ticket coordinates release notes, sample kits, SDK releases (js/python/go), console telemetry wiring, and cross-team handoffs so we ship a consistent experience and can rapidly rollback/iterate if regressions appear.
scope: Release notes draft and localized snippets
Sample kits for JS + Python + Go demonstrating: structured output schema, function-calling patterns, streaming partials
Console dashboard updates and telemetry dashboards (canary + GA)
Rollout playbook: canary thresholds, rollback triggers, fallback models
Cross-team comms: PM, Eng, Design, Docs, DevRel, Support, Sales enablement
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in Confluence + assets linked in product site
Sample repo PR merged and versioned packages published to staging package feeds
Automated smoke tests for structured output and function calling pass in staging
Canary telemetry dashboards created and alerted (latency, token cost, error rate)
Clear handoff checklist completed and sign-offs from Eng lead and Docs lead

risks: Regression in streaming endpoint increases token latency under certain batch sizes
Ambiguous structured-output examples could cause bad integrations by customers
SDK dependency mismatch across languages delays GA publishing
Telemetry not firing for function-calling leads to blindspots during canary
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (Canary internal): deploy SDK RC + API flags to 5% internal traffic — monitor 48h
Stage 1 (External canary): enable for partners and beta customers with SLA waiver — monitor 72h
Stage 2 (Gradual ramp): 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days with automated rollback on threshold breaches
Fallback policy: route to compatible model variant (smaller quantized) if latency SLO breached
Post-GA: run 14-day quality sweep on eval prompt set and open a regression-triage channel
